notes: S3 probe-context test. Importing the touched modules needs NO configured settings on 2.2 (django.conf.urls.url, django.utils.six, force_text, urlquote, ugettext, ugettext_lazy, django.http, django.urls all import fine without settings; app.core and app.urls import fine too, since ugettext_lazy builds its proxy lazily). But CALLING ugettext / hello_url (reverse) / str(ugettext_lazy(..)) without settings raises ImproperlyConfigured ('Requested setting USE_I18N, but settings are not configured'), while force_text, urlquote, six, url() and escape work without settings. Tests configure settings in tests/conftest.py (pytest_configure: settings.configure(...) + django.setup()); a probe that imports the app outside pytest has no settings, so the calls that need them land in import_errors / INCONCLUSIVE unless the probe sets DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE or configures settings. On 4.2 the removed names fail at import with ImportError regardless of settings (url, six, force_text, urlquote, ugettext, ugettext_lazy), so app.core and app.urls cannot even be imported, and new-side facts must come from the migrated code. Old side (2.2.28) emits NO warnings (2.2 has no RemovedInDjango40Warning for these); target is 4.2.30 (LTS), not 5.x, since 5.0 would additionally flip USE_TZ default and drop more. S1: escape() returns SafeText vs SafeString (str subclasses; the string content differs in the change scenario). is_ajax removal is an AttributeError on a WSGIRequest built by RequestFactory. No ground-truth entry was dropped for django, but none needs C-level warnings. manual_migration edits are applied in order; extra keys: 'if_present' (skip when the text is absent, e.g. pymolt already rewrote that site) and 'replace_all'. Ground-truth entries with 'scenario':'change' only exist after the change scenario's edits. 'expected_changed' is a guess at the traced symbol name.
